description: This source file defines the EntityConditionBuilder class, which extends BuilderSupport to facilitate building EntityCondition objects through a builder pattern, typically for constructing complex query conditions within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to create, manage, and set parent-child relationships between condition nodes, supports various operators, and wraps conditions for further evaluation.

classes.name: EntityConditionBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating complex EntityCondition objects used in dynamic query construction within the OFBiz framework. It supports various condition operators and node creation methods.

classes.name: ConditionHolder
classes.description: A private static inner class implementing EntityCondition, encapsulating an EntityCondition instance to adapt it within the builder and to handle condition evaluation and string generation.

methods.name: createNode (Object methodName)
methods.description: Creates a new ConditionHolder with an EntityCondition based on the specified join operator, used when a method with only the method name is invoked.

methods.name: createNode (Object methodName, Object objArg)
methods.description: Creates a new ConditionHolder with an EntityCondition and assigns a parent node using the second argument.

methods.name: createNode (Object methodName, Map mapArg)
methods.description: Creates a set of conditions based on the map of field-value pairs and the comparison operator specified, returning a ConditionHolder wrapping the resulting condition(s).

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Adds a child condition to the parent ConditionHolder's condition list, updating the parent's condition accordingly.
